purpose: Establish structural epistemic clarity rules for NDH systems inspired by the moral visibility ethos of the White Rose.

principles.clarity_over_noise: Prioritize structural clarity over rhetorical ambiguity.
principles.non_absorptive_ethics: Identify patterns without internalizing harm or coercive narratives.
principles.survivor_centered_visibility: Ensure evidence of harm is not minimized or procedurally flattened.
principles.actor_neutral_analysis: Evaluate patterns, not people; no motive inference or persuasion.
principles.provenance_integrity: Maintain traceability to ledger, CAUSA, substrate, and horizon descriptors.
principles.collapse_safe_reconstruction: Charter remains functional even if other artifacts collapse.

lineage.notes: Ethical clarity, truth visibility, non-absorption of harm.
